In mathematical [[representation theory]], two [[group representation|representations]] of a [[group (mathematics)|group]] on [[topological vector space]]s are called '''Naimark equivalent''' (named after [[Mark Naimark]]) if there is a closed bijective linear map between [[dense subspace]]s preserving the [[Group action (mathematics)|group action]].
